name: Varibar Pudding
indications_original:
VARIBAR PUDDING is indicated for modified barium swallow examinations
to evaluate the oral and pharyngeal function and morphology in adult
and pediatric patients 6 months of age and older.
contraindications_original: For oral use only – administered by syringe or spoon ( 2.1 ) Adults:  5 mL Pediatric patients:  1-3 mL Multiple doses may be administered Maximum cumulative dose : 30 mL
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
VARIBAR PUDDING is an off-white to lightly colored ready-to-use paste with a vanilla aroma for oral administration supplied in multiple-dose polyethylene tubes containing either 30 mL or 230 mL of barium sulfate (40% w/v).
                        Provided as: 24 X 30 mL tubes (NDC 32909-125-54); 12 X 230 mL tubes (NDC 32909-125-22)
adverseReactions_original:
VARIBAR PUDDING is contraindicated in patients with:
                  - known or suspected perforation of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract;- known obstruction of the GI tract;- high risk of GI perforation such as those with a recent GI perforation, acute GI hemorrhage or ischemia, toxic megacolon, severe ileus, post GI surgery or biopsy, acute GI injury or burn, or recent radiotherapy to the pelvis;- high risk for aspiration such as those with known or suspected tracheo-esophageal fistula or obtundation;- known hypersensitivity to barium sulfate or any of the excipients of VARIBAR PUDDING.
